metadata.sourceNotes: Source follow-up pass 45: official bathing-water profile supports Imeros beach identity/location in Rodopi. Confidence, coordinates, access, services, amenities, wind profile, and scoring were not changed. Popular source-backed confidence pass BF 2026-06-02: official Imeros bathing-water profile/PDF support Imeros in the Rodopi coast, Municipality of Maroneia-Sapes, on the inner part of Ormos Anoikto, 3,400 m beach length, 25 m average width, south orientation, natural sandy coastal zone and sandy seabed, normal first-metre depth, gentle seabed slope, 5 m isobath around 400 m from shore, road access for the eastern swimming section, difficult access for common vehicles on the western section, unorganized status, limited visitation and only a limited number of bins. Promoted to high for static metadata only; unsupported snorkeling/surfing app activity flags are pinned false. Source wind-protection, rare-wave, water-quality and current-condition wording was not imported into windProfile, scoring or calm/protected/safe claims. Reverse amenity sweep 2026-07-19 (no-API): organized flag corrected to true — our own editorial story explicitly describes an organized beach (sunbeds added from the story).
